procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
CHN is represented by | Moning Xu [helm]
CAN in represented by | Alvin Wang [helm]
Lin Lu team leder of CHN, attended the hearing as an observer.
Nicolas Tosi, coach of CAN attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: CHN returned ashore as last of the Nacra fleet.
Once ashore the helm of CHN washed the boat and then collected the mobile to submit the protest.
The mobile of the helm of CHN was in the car parked in the boat park 200m far from boat parking place.
There were no damages nor injuries.
conclusions: CHN failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3.
There was no good reason for the international jury to extend the time limit. Therefore the is invalid under RRS 60.4(a)
decision: Protest is invalid and the hering is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1)
